item.title: Wasserstrom Acquires Breckenridge Kitchen Equipment & Design
item.description: The Wasserstrom Company has acquired Breckenridge Kitchen Equipment & Design, a foodservice equipment and design firm headquartered in Huron, Ohio. item.title: Reliance Global To Buy Controlling Stake In Enquantum
item.description: Reliance Global Group announced it has signed a non-binding term sheet to acquire a controlling interest in Enquantum Ltd., positioning the proposed deal as the first transaction under a newly established subsidiary, EZRA International Group, that will target controlling stakes in high-tech businesses. item.title: Bain Capital Acquires APP Jet Center, Entering Fixed-Base Operator Sector
item.description: Bain Capital has entered the fixed-base operator (FBO) sector with the acquisition of APP Jet Center, a provider of aviation services at high-quality, supply-constrained airports in the United States.
